# Living Design System | Icons &nbsp; [![Build Status](https://ci.falcon2.walmart.com/buildStatus/icon?job=LivingDesign%2Ficons)](https://ci.falcon2.walmart.com/job/LivingDesign/job/icons/)

A set of PDF, React component, React font, and SVG icons built by Living Design.

## Getting started

```sh
npm install @livingdesign/icons
```

## Overview

The icons are available through the following formats:

- PDF
- React component
- React font
- SVG
- Android

## Usage

### PDF

Available under `@livingdesign/icons/dist/pdf`.

### React component

```tsx
import {Spark} from '@livingdesign/icons';

export default () => <Spark />;
```

### React font

```tsx
import '@livingdesign/icons/dist/font/LivingDesign.{version}.css';
import {Icon} from '@livingdesign/icons';

export default () => <Icon name="Spark" />;
```

**NOTE**: Font files must be managed by the consumer. They are available within the module, but are also available statically. Each release of this package will have an accompanying URL for the corresponding CSS file. See [PRONTO.md](./PRONTO.md).

### SVG

Available under `@livingdesign/icons/dist/svg`.

### Mega scale

Mega is Living Design's scaled-up experience for tablet screens where the regular scale is too small for users. Mega scale modifies icon sizes only--it does not affect icon names or designs.

Mega's scale factor is applied consistently to the size of the icons, i.e., each icon is scaled up 150%.

To use Mega icons, add `mega` in the import path.

#### React component

```tsx
import {Spark} from "@livingdesign/icons/mega";
export default () => <Spark />;
```

#### React font

```tsx
import "@livingdesign/icons/dist/mega/font/LivingDesign.{version}.css";
import {Icon} from "@livingdesign/icons/mega";
export default () => <Icon name="Spark" />;
```

### Android

1. Ensure the project is configured to use Walmart's Proximity repository. Add in [a Maven repository](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/declaring_repositories.html#sec:maven_repo) in `build.gradle`:

   ```groovy
   allprojects {
       repositories {
           maven { url walmartProximityRepository }
       }
   }
   ```

   Then, set `walmartProximityRepository` in `gradle.properties`:

   ```ini
   walmartProximityRepository=https://repository.walmart.com/content/repositories/pangaea_releases
   ```

2. Add the library as a dependency in `app/build.gradle`:

   ```groovy
   dependencies {
       implementation 'com.walmart.android.ld:living-design-icons:0.0.0'
   }
   ```

   Check the [repository's release page](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/icons/releases) to find the latest version.

3. The icons will be available as drawable resources, prefixed by `ld_`, e.g. `android:drawableStart="@drawable/ld_check"`.

## Contributing

### Request a new icon

To request a new icon, open an issue using the [icon request](https://jira.walmart.com/servicedesk/admin/LD/request-types/group/10289) template.

### Adding or updating an icon

Read through our [contributing guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-or-updating-icons) if you want to add or update icons.
